# Sales Enablement

`aaj-sales-enablement` · v1.0.0 · Execute · Sales & Pipeline
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/aaj-sales-enablement/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Which sales assets should we build, fix or check first, given the deals we lost for want of them?

**Inputs:** Every sales asset that exists with its type, owner, last update and how many reps use it; the number of quota-carrying reps; and closed-lost reasons from the last two quarters with counts and value

**Output:** Coverage per deal stage with the needs that have no asset; each asset marked ok or fix for staleness, no owner or low adoption; and a ranked list of what to build, fix or check, each with the revenue lost for want of it and a verdict on where to start

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill aaj-sales-enablement`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/aaj-sales-enablement/resources/enablement-audit.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/aaj-sales-enablement/resources/enablement-audit.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- Adoption is only as good as the rep counts you enter. Download or view counts from a content system are not the same as use in a deal; ask the reps.
- The six-month staleness and one-third adoption cut-offs are this engine's rules, not standards. A battlecard or pricing answer can go stale sooner.
- Lost value is counted under every asset type a reason maps to, so the list ranks what would have helped and is not a sum. With no loss reasons it cannot rank at all.
- Asset types and loss reasons must use its fixed labels. An unlisted type such as "battle card" is flagged but not counted toward coverage.

**Review before acting:** The sales lead confirms the rep-usage counts and that loss reasons are coded consistently, and each asset owner checks the fix findings before anything new is built.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/aaj-sales-enablement](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/aaj-sales-enablement)
